description: Department of Local Government Uva Province - Rules for the Preparations and enforcement of MC, UC & PS Budgets-2020 in Uva Province
reasoning: This gazette content establishes rules and procedures for municipal budget preparation and enforcement under the Municipal Council Ordinance. It creates a regulatory framework for financial governance at the local government level, including specific procedures for budget drafting, approval processes, voting mechanisms, and compliance requirements. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
